privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We care about protecting your personal data and processing it transparently and securely. This page summarizes which data we collect, how we use it and your rights.

sections.lead1: We care about protecting your personal data. Below we summarize which data we collect, how we use it and your rights. For details, please contact us.
sections.lead2: We implement reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your data. For privacy questions, requests or complaints, please contact us.
sections.personalData: Your name, email address, phone number and other information you enter into contact forms. We may also collect cookies and technical data related to site usage (IP address, browser information, page views, etc.).
sections.whyUse: We use collected data to respond to your requests, deliver and improve our services, manage order/quote processes and to fulfill our legal obligations.
sections.sharing: Your data is not shared with third parties unless you give explicit consent or when required by law. Limited, purpose-bound sharing with subcontractors (e.g., shipping, payment providers) may occur; such transfers are carried out securely.
sections.rights: Right to access and correct your data; right to request deletion or restriction of processing; right to object to processing and data portability.
sections.cookies: Performance and analytics cookies may be used on the site. You can manage or disable cookies via your browser settings; some features may not function properly if cookies are disabled.
sections.securityContact: We apply reasonable technical and administrative measures to protect your data. For privacy-related questions, requests or complaints, please contact us.
